authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES the FX-5 four revocation-position initial states from permission-truth-tables.v9. v2 lands CLAUDE-FX5-SF1 by restoring fx5Intent to the full live v9 intent and carrying the three v9 asserts as named-not-authored. It does not author journal bytes. It does not invent a revocation-state envelope. It does not invent a cleanup-bound number. It does not invent raceSemantics outcome values. It does not execute FX-5. It does not close OBL-FX-AUTHORING. It does not SATISFY DR-105. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Continue leftover-design of OBL-FX-AUTHORING at FX-5 without inventing journal or revocation-state envelopes. v2 restores the full v9 intent after CLAUDE-FX5-SF1. Journals, commit records, raceSemantics values, and cleanup-bound measurements remain unauthored.

pttV9.fx5Intent: File 03's own four conformance positions, carried whole: revocation before acceptance; after acceptance but before reversible commit; racing an irreversible effect-commit; and between successive broker calls. For each, assert the deterministic outcome named in raceSemantics, assert no post-revocation commit record exists, and assert cleanup closed within its declared bound. The split label is not hedging: the fixture genuinely enforces that the HOST commits nothing after r, and genuinely cannot speak to what the component did on its own.
pttV9.fx5Proves: ENFORCEMENT of the host's own commit path; DISCLOSURE with respect to ambient authority
